source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.1「無人航空機の種類と特徴」

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: パワードリフト機は垂直離着陸性と飛行機型の前進飛行性を組み合わせる。
evidence.tested_misconception: powered-liftは飛行機またはマルチローターのどちらか一方の特徴しか持たない。
evidence.reasoning_path: mission needs -> hybrid aircraft characteristic -> select powered-lift

collision.note: LOW。既存Q060は飛行機の高速・高効率・長距離適性であり、powered-liftのhybrid characteristicは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.1 supports powered-lift as the combination of vertical takeoff/landing capability and airplane-like forward cruise; no canonical item tests this hybrid-aircraft proposition.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
